text: Social media becomes more meaningful and effective. <break time="0.8s" /> When the firm uses it. <break time="0.8s" /> To collaborate with clients. <break time="0.8s" /> To develop new products or services. <break time="0.8s" /> As this collaboration or co creation helps create value. <break time="0.8s" /> For both firm and clients. <break time="0.8s" /> Clients become part of the creation and delivery of products and services. <break time="0.8s" /> And therefore become more invested. <break time="0.8s" /> In the firm and its performance outcomes. <break time="0.8s" /> Social media can effectively assist in client co creation. <break time="0.8s" /> By enabling clients to build better connections with firms. <break time="0.8s" /> Because they can communicate their thoughts, ideas, hopes, needs, and desires. <break time="0.8s" /> To firms more easily. <break time="0.8s" /> They can interact. <break time="0.8s" /> With other users of the firms products or services. <break time="0.8s" /> And share ideas with them. <break time="0.8s" /> They can experience a sense of community. <break time="0.8s" /> With these other users. <break time="0.8s" /> Identify with them. <break time="0.8s" /> And eventually develop closer relationships. <break time="0.8s" /> With the firm and its products and services. <break time="0.8s" /> Social media thus creates value both for clients and firms. <break time="0.8s" /> By facilitating co creation and enabling engagement.
